NSH.head: A steep climb for Nashville
NSH.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Nashville has home ice. Nashville’s best hope is keeping the shots to the outside, plus a big night in goal.

VGK.head: A big edge for Vegas
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Nashville has home ice. Nashville’s only real way in is keeping the shots to the outside, and it would need a near-perfect night.
